The plate is square and spans about 440 px of the 640 px image width. If it is a dinner plate of roughly 26 cm, that gives about 0.06 cm per pixel.

The main item looks like crumbled or torn mozzarella, or possibly scrambled egg white. It covers about 150 px by 230 px, which is roughly 9 cm by 13 cm at its extremes, but it is irregular and sparse. I estimate its area at about 60 cm² with a height of about 1.5 cm, giving a volume of roughly 70 cm³. At about 1 g/cm³ that would be about 70 g, but the pieces are loose, so I'll say about 60 g.

There is also a small piece in the top right, about 1.5 cm across, which I estimate at 3 g. A sprinkle of black pepper covers part of the main item and is negligible.

Because the main item could be mozzarella, I'm using about 250 kcal per 100 g for it. The small piece looks like cheese or bread, and I'm using the same value for it.
